title: Up days and down days
statementMd:
For symbol `CLOUD`, count days that closed above their open (`up`), below (`down`) or equal (`flat`).

Expected columns: `direction`, `days`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN close > open THEN 'up' WHEN close < open THEN 'down' ELSE 'flat' END AS direction, COUNT(*) AS days FROM prices WHERE symbol = 'CLOUD' GROUP BY direction;
```
